title: Jewelry Buyer Leads
description: CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers and appraisers in Atlanta from people selling gold, seeking appraisals or buying rings.
html:
Jewelry Buyer Leads Atlanta

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers in Atlanta. The leads come from people looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or buy an engagement ring.

What you get

First 3 leads free, $40 per accepted lead, optional Pro website widget for $12/month

Why CaratBase

CaratBase helps independent jewelers and estate buyers find new customers in the Atlanta area.

FAQ

How much does the service cost? First 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

Is the website widget required? No. The Pro website widget is optional and costs $12/month; free widgets are also available.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
